changeSet.author: sxiva
changeSet.comment: Add dopamine resistance counter columns (triggers, resisted, indulged; half points allowed) to daily_summary table
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE daily_summary ADD COLUMN drc_triggers NUMERIC(5,1), ADD COLUMN drc_resisted NUMERIC(5,1), ADD COLUMN drc_indulged NUMERIC(5,1);
changeSet.rollback: ALTER TABLE daily_summary DROP COLUMN drc_triggers, DROP COLUMN drc_resisted, DROP COLUMN drc_indulged;
